name: Brush Wipe
description: A few broad brush strokes sweep across the frame in turn, back and forth, painting in the second clip with streaky bristle edges and dry, ragged ends. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: strokes
params.description: Number of brush strokes needed to cover the frame

params.name: angle
params.description: Angle of the strokes, in degrees

params.name: roughness
params.description: How rough the bristles make the edges and ends of the strokes

params.name: waviness
params.description: How much the strokes wave along their way
